description: Put the app through lifecycle events and interruptions. background sends it to the background (iOS: inactive then background; Android: blur then background), interrupt makes it inactive like the app switcher or a call, return brings it back; `duration` ('5s', '31m') returns by itself, and skipWait with a duration moves the app clock instead of waiting (needs @buoy-gg/clock), which tests session timeouts in one call. memory_warning, open_url (`url`), press_back (Android; never exits the app, reports whether a screen handled it), color_scheme (`scheme`), battery (`level` 0-1, `lowPowerMode`, `state`; needs expo-battery, react-native-device-info or @capacitor/device), reset_battery, relaunch (restarts the app's JS, then checks where it landed), recipe (`id`, see get_lifecycle), clear_report, reset (end every simulation). Simulations reach the app's JS listeners only: nothing is suspended and the next real OS event wins. With `real: true` (iOS Simulator or Android), background/return/relaunch/color_scheme/open_url cause the real OS event instead (relaunch then kills the process, a real cold start). App control, iOS Simulator or Android, no lifecycle package needed: quit closes the app, launch opens it (works while it is closed), reinstall (`appPath`: a simulator .app or an .apk) wipes its data like a new user and keeps Buoy's sign-in on iOS, boot_simulator (`simulator`) starts an iOS Simulator. Read get_lifecycle afterwards for the report.

appPath.description: reinstall (required): the built app, a simulator .app folder or an Android .apk.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

duration.description: background / interrupt: return by itself after this long ('5s', '5m', ms). Omit to stay until return.

id.description: recipe (required): a recipe id from get_lifecycle, e.g. 'away-31m'.

keepBuoySignIn.description: reinstall, iOS: keep Buoy's sign-in and device id. Default true.

lowPowerMode.description: battery: low power mode on or off.

mode.description: color_scheme: 'js' emits the change to JS listeners (default); 'native' overrides the app's native appearance too.

real.description: Cause the real OS event on the iOS Simulator or Android device (background, return, relaunch, color_scheme, open_url).

reportWindow.description: settings: how long reports keep collecting after the app returns ('5s').

serial.description: Android: the adb serial, when several devices are connected.

showChip.description: settings: show the floating status chip while simulating.

simulator.description: boot_simulator (required): simulator name or udid, e.g. "iPhone 17 Pro".

skipWait.description: background / interrupt: move the app clock forward by `duration` and return at once. Needs @buoy-gg/clock.

udid.description: The simulator udid, when it can't be found by itself.

url.description: open_url (required): the link, with its scheme.

name: lifecycle_action
